clauses.text: No Bill for the amendment of any provisio of the Constitution shall be placed on the Order Paper o Parliament, unless the provision to be repealed, altered o added, and consequential amendments, if any, ar expressly specified in the Bill and is described in the long title thereof as being an Act for the amendment of th Constitution.

No Bill for the repeal of the Constitution shall b placed on the Order Paper of Parliament unless the Bil contains provisions replacing the Constitution and i described in the long title thereof as being an Act for th repeal and replacement of the Constitution.

Notwithstanding anything in the preceding provisions of this Article, it shall be lawful for a Bil which complies with the requirements of paragraph
of this Article to be amended by Parliamen provided that the Bill as so amended shall comply with those requirements.

A Bill for the amendment of any provision of th Constitution or for the repeal and replacement of th Constitution, shall become law if the number of votes cas in favour thereof amounts to not less than two-thirds o the whole number of Members (including those no present) and upon a certificate by the President or th Speaker, as the case may be, being endorsed thereon in accordance with the provisions of Article 80 or 79. titution of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka

No provision in any law shall, or shall be deemed to, amend, repeal or replace the Constitution or any provision thereof, or be so interpreted or construed, unless enacted in accordance with the requirements of the preceding provisions of this Article.
In this Chapter, “amendment” includes repeal, alteration and addition.
